summary: Phase 4 (the last phase) of the fleet map rework: the map becomes three panes - the twin-tree rail, a stage, and a new right-hand inspector - and the floating popup cards are gone. fleet_map.js now holds ONE selection state (sel: {type:'site'|'area'|'camera'|'node', ...}) instead of a separate drill-down state plus a floating popup that could each be showing something different; the stage (stagePlan) is derived from it so it can never drift from the pane describing it. Selecting an area (from the tree, the inspector, or a 'locate this camera' jump) now renders that area's floor plan inline on the stage, beside the tree, with a breadcrumb (Everywhere / place / area, a point asset's implicit area left unnamed) instead of the old drill-down's own header and back button. The new inspector pane (map/inspector.js, rewritten from inert PR #125 scaffolding that referenced i18n keys which never existed) shows one contextual card for whatever is selected: a place (its areas, camera count, whether it's on the map, the way into the editor), a camera (recent events with infinite scroll, Open live, Locate), or an appliance - the card this rework exists for, listing 'Where its cameras are' as one row per place with a camera count (a recorder feeding three places gets three rows, which no single siteId field could ever carry) and separately 'Where the appliance itself is' (its box pin, or unpinned/no-fixed-location), with an unreachable appliance's unplaced count shown as '?' rather than 0. map/floor_view.js's FloorPlanView (also inert until now) renders one area's plan, coverage wedges and camera markers with no chrome of its own - the flatter monitor-mode surface an inline stage needs, without the older BuildingFloorView drill-down's 2D vector wall/stair overlay, 2D/3D toggle, stack-floors option or per-camera notification badges, all of which remain editor-only for now. Deleted as superseded: map/popups.js (NodeCameraPopup + MapPopupFrame, the floating cards the inspector replaces; its two node-media URL builders moved to the new map/media_src.js), map/asset_browser.js and map/geo_map.js (inert PR #125 scaffolding, superseded by twin_tree.js and the live geographic map respectively) - nothing under components/map/ is unwired scaffolding any more. styles/twin-tree.css gains the .fleet-map-inspector pane, using border-inline-start rather than map-workspace.css's .mw-inspector class so the pane still mirrors correctly in Arabic. Live footage stays a floating window on purpose - watching a camera while navigating elsewhere is the point of it. This completes all five phases of the map rework (0 refactor, 1 point-asset areas, 2 the two trees, 3 the box pin and the tray's verbs, 4 three panes). 16 new insp.* i18n keys added across en/ms/zh/ar.
compatibility: Backward compatible for existing installs - no schema, API, or config changes; every endpoint the map calls is unchanged. Existing site/area/placement data displays exactly as before, just through the new three-pane shell instead of the old popup/drill-down pair. One functional narrowing versus the prior read-only drill-down: the map's inline floor-plan stage no longer shows the 2D vector wall/stair/door overlay, the 2D/3D toggle, the 'stack floors' option, or per-camera unread-notification badges on the plan itself (those remain available in the authoring editor, floor_editor.js/floor_3d.js); an operator gets a camera's unread events from the inspector card instead. No operator or migration action is required.
